Police are using the recovered number plate to trace the fleeing driver.

With around eighty percent of startups facing failure, it's crucial for entrepreneurs to not be weighed down by each setback.

Factors such as habitat destruction and rampant wildfires have severely impacted the species over the years, while the encroaching barred owl emerges as a formidable threat.

Instead, he suggests implementing financial penalties that escalate with repeated infractions, potentially involving the bowler’s coach. The French Defence emerged from a 1834 correspondence match between Paris and London. Berlin Defence, meanwhile, was revived by Vladimir Kramnik in his 2000 world championship match against Garry Kasparov.
title: ‘CoE cannot be only for contracted players’: VVS Laxman on India’s cricket pipeline

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Joe Root has made history by scoring the most Test runs for England, eclipsing Ricky Ponting's record in a thrilling match against Pakistan. This landmark not only highlights Root's outstanding performance in his home Tests but also sets him on the path to chase Sachin Tendulkar's overall record as England triumphs in the series at Lord's.
title: Joe Root scripts history vs Pak at Lord’s, surpasses Ponting’s all-time record

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In a landmark move, the United States and Venezuela have forged a 25-year energy partnership designed to uplift Venezuela's ailing oil sector and enhance production capabilities. Under this agreement, rights to unexplored oil reserves will be held for a century, with the U.S. claiming fifty-five percent of the new venture's output. This collaboration promises to inject significant investments and generate tax income for Venezuela.
title: US-Venezuela energy pact: What we know about Trump’s ‘biggest oil deal in world history’

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A proposed 31-unit Airstream “glamping” resort in Solvang, the picturesque California town once home to Dolly Parton, has sparked fierce opposition from residents and city officials. Plans for the former lumberyard include hotel suites, a pool, bar and lookout tower. Critics say the trailer-style development clashes with Solvang’s historic architectural character.
title: Danish-style California town opposes 31-Airstream resort plan

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Suryakumar Yadav openly takes responsibility for his underwhelming ODI career, admitting he lacked the necessary dedication to the 50-over format. He struggles with the complexities of ODI cricket compared to T20s and expresses regret over not mastering the art of innings construction. Yadav reflects that his journey in ODI cricket feels incomplete and remains a lingering aspiration.
title: ‘ I take the blame myself’: Suryakumar Yadav’s big regret over failed ODI career

title: Police officer killed, another wounded in South Carolina park shooting; suspect dead

author: TNN
description: Seven unidentified bodies have been recovered from the Gandak river in Uttar Pradesh. Devastating floods in Nepal caused a sharp rise in the river's water flow. Officials are working to identify the deceased individuals found in the water. Bodies were discovered in Maharajganj and Kushinagar districts by villagers and SSB personnel. Efforts are ongoing to manage the situation and identify the recovered victims.
title: 7 bodies swept into Gandak river in Maharajganj, Kushinagar amid Nepal floods

title: Union, Canara Bank to appeal NCLT's Chandra order

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A man in Sichuan, China, has spent seven years carving a two-storey family home directly into a sandstone mountain. Documented by YouTube channel Quantum Makers, the solo project faced water leaks, heavy storms, hidden fissures, humidity and a two-year pause. After extensive repairs and upgrades, the once-raw mountain space is now a livable home.
title: Man carves 2-storey home into China mountain in 7 years, makes it livable

author: TNN
description: BJP and Congress clashed over allegations of rally venue purification. Rahul Gandhi demanded an FIR, linking it to untouchability practices. BJP rebutted charges, showing organizers' videos and questioning the delay. Organizers stated a hawan followed cleaning for Ramlila, denying BJP links. Both parties exchanged accusations regarding caste divisions and past incidents.
title: Congress & BJP clash over Haldwani ‘purification’ row, Rahul seeks FIR

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Toxic recorded a decline in its India net collection on Saturday. The film earned an estimated Rs 24.50 crore net in India on Day 4. Its total India net collection has now reached Rs 190.45 crore. Worldwide gross collection for Toxic has reached Rs 254.75 crore. The Hindi version emerged as the biggest contributor on Saturday.
title: Toxic Day 4: Yash starrer dips 9.9%, crosses Rs 254.75 cr worldwide

title: Trump-Putin-Zelenskyy summit floated in secret Moscow talks: Report

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Andre Agassi made significant sacrifices during his own childhood to ensure his children could experience life freely. Becoming a father to Jaden and Jaz shifted his priorities, emphasizing their happiness over his own athletic legacy. His wife, Steffi Graf, who also faced the rigorous demands of elite sports, shared this perspective, allowing them to focus on nurturing their children's individual passions.
title: Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf’s unique approach to raising their children

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Sally Kellerman’s adopted daughter Claire Kellerman is embroiled in a legal dispute on Scotland’s Great Bernera over her Australian cattle dog, which she says is an assistance animal. She has sued a community-run cafe under the Equality Act, while local groups face mounting legal bills. Kellerman calls the backlash a “witch hunt” and insists, “I’m not going anywhere.”
title: Sally Kellerman's daughter refuses to leave Scottish island in assistance dog row
